payload.rationale: PRODUCT.md 33 recommends these three starting terms and the dogfood corpus supports them: ET-BERT (W0001) tokenises raw datagram bytes with no field parsing; NetGPT (W0002) serialises bytes to hex AND treats header fields as separable units, so it is hybrid; RAPIER (W0004) consumes behaviour feature vectors rather than a token sequence. 'unclear' stays available and multi-label placement is permitted; widening the list is a new Decision, not a plugin edit.
